description: Bike Sharing - Rentals is a dataset listed in Comune di Bologna open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Comune di Bologna. Data related to the monthly rental of the bike-sharing service. It includes the kilometers traveled, hours of use, and the number of rentals. The data is provided by SRM, the agency for mobility and public transport of the Municipality of Bologna and the Metropolitan City of Bologna. Coverage: Bologna. The portal files it under Trasporti. The portal shows 87 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-03-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-comune-bologna-it-portal.
